note: Multiple clinical studies directly report that individuals with MAPK8IP3 missense variants exhibit more severe symptoms and prominent brain anomalies than those with loss-of-function variants.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 32 individuals with MAPK8IP3-related neurodevelopmental disorder, missense variants were specifically associated with more severe clinical symptoms than predicted loss-of-function variants.

source.title: Comprehensive Clinical Characteristics, Longitudinal Adaptive Functioning, and Electroencephalogram Activity in MAPK8IP3‐Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: Missense variants were associated with more severe symptoms than LOF variants.

evidence.text: Recurrent de novo missense variants in MAPK8IP3 were consistently associated with major structural brain anomalies, including perisylvian polymicrogyria, cerebral or cerebellar atrophy, and corpus callosum hypoplasia.

source.title: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3 cause intellectual disability with variable brain anomalies
source.quote: Brain anomalies such as perisylvian polymicrogyria, cerebral or cerebellar atrophy, and hypoplasia of the corpus callosum were consistent among individuals harboring recurrent de novo missense variants.
